title: euphrasia arctica var. mollis
intro: Euphrasia arctica var. mollis, commonly known as Arctic Eyebright, is a plant species that belongs to the family Orobanchaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include treating eye and throat irritations, as well as coughs and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Arctic Eyebright include its ability to soothe and calm irritated tissues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity against various pathogens. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and are responsible for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
